instruction:
Using the official World Bank API response for the Population, total indicator covering India, Brazil, and Nigeria from 2020 through 2026, identify the latest year for which all three countries have non-null values. Report that common year, each country’s exact value, and rank the countries from highest to lowest population.

Stopping condition: Stop after the latest common non-null year, all three exact population values, and the descending ranking have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only the official API response at the supplied URL.
- Do not substitute data from the blocked World Bank visual-data page or another source.
- Treat null as unavailable and do not infer or interpolate missing values.
- Preserve the full integer values rather than rounding them.
